title: Scientific Normalization & Acceptance Semantics for the Bounded Richards Temporal Indicator
scope: owner-level scientific/numerical semantics assessment only; no production acceptance implementation, retry-policy binding, coupling release or empirical calibration

semantic_separation.indicator: B_inf is a bounded-stiffness-aware head-domain temporal indicator with exact-linear bound evidence and qualified nonlinear transfer evidence in a restricted envelope.
semantic_separation.normalization: A dimensionless mapping may express B_inf relative to an independently supplied accuracy budget, but the mapping itself must not create a true-error guarantee that B_inf does not possess.
semantic_separation.application_budget: An application/numerical accuracy budget is an explicit external policy/configuration quantity with scientific or application provenance; it is not inferred from F-SI24/F-VQ30/F-VQ31 case outcomes.
semantic_separation.acceptance_policy: F-KT acceptance/retry mechanics are downstream and separate; F-SI26 may only define candidate certificate semantics.
semantic_separation.mass: Mass conservation remains an independent hard gate and may not be traded against temporal accuracy.
semantic_separation.coupling: Groundwater head/flux interface residual tolerances are separate coupling requirements and may not be silently reused as the Richards temporal budget.

candidate_classes.H_budget_requirement: positive finite explicit external head-domain temporal-indicator budget in cm
candidate_classes.nonclaim: C_h<=1 means indicator within configured budget, not proven true solution error <= H_budget

candidate_classes.reason: Choosing H_builtin from observed cases or legacy solver tolerances would be empirical/semantic overreach.
Can permit large absolute head deviations in dry states and risks becoming a state-dependent rescue factor without an independent scientific contract.

candidate_classes.mapping: M-weighted or storage-equivalent scalar used as sole temporal certificate
candidate_classes.reason: Mass is independently exact and storage sensitivity does not by itself guarantee head or interface-flux accuracy.

candidate_classes.mapping: normalize B_inf directly by groundwater coupling head/flux tolerance
candidate_classes.reason: Coupling residuals belong to the coupler/application contract and are not universal soil-water temporal-accuracy semantics.

candidate_classes.mapping: retain dimensional B_inf without <=1 production certificate
candidate_classes.reason: Preserves useful bounded-cost signal without manufacturing an accuracy guarantee.

gates.A_EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION: Reconcile exact-linear positive evidence, nonlinear conservatism, retry nonmonotonicity, unavailable true reference and F-KT09's generic dimensionless certificate contract without upgrading evidence strength.
gates.B_DIMENSIONAL_AND_SEMANTIC_VALIDITY: Any candidate mapping is dimensionally coherent, monotone in B_inf for fixed supplied budget, finite only for valid inputs and has an exact non-overclaiming interpretation.
gates.C_NO_EMPIRICAL_RESCUE: No scale, multiplier, floor, material/state coefficient or default tolerance is fitted from F-SI23/F-SI24/F-VQ28/F-VQ29/F-VQ30/F-VQ31 outcomes.
gates.D_ERROR_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: The candidate does not convert finite-comparator consistency into a general nonlinear true-error bound and does not reinterpret N512 or any refinement endpoint as truth.
gates.E_APPLICATION_BUDGET_SEPARATION: If an external budget is used, its provenance, unit and owner are explicit and separate from nonlinear solver tolerances, hard mass tolerance, coupling residual tolerance and legacy timestep heuristics.
gates.F_RETRY_SEMANTIC_SAFETY: The candidate does not assume B_inf or its normalized value decreases monotonically with shorter dt; downstream F-KT retry must remain bounded/fail-closed and independently qualified.
gates.G_EDGE_AND_DISCONTINUITY_BEHAVIOR: Invalid/nonpositive/nonfinite budget, unavailable indicator, unsupported operator envelope, initial warmup, restart mismatch and forcing/event/topology discontinuity are fail-closed/unavailable unless separately qualified.
gates.H_FKT09_COMPATIBILITY: Any dimensionless candidate fits F-KT09's available+finite+nonnegative+<=1 interface without changing F-KT09 generic semantics or selecting policy here.
gates.I_ARCHITECTURE_INVARIANTS: Explicitly assess invariants 7,8,9,11,12,13,15,20,23,24,25,26,29,30; no coupling or F-PE release.

hard_holds: No empirical safety factor or calibration coefficient.
No q_cap, Nmin, geometric-tail multiplier or retrospective machine-floor inflation.
No universal built-in temporal head tolerance selected from existing evidence.
Do not reuse CritDevH nonlinear convergence criteria as temporal accuracy budgets.
Do not infer monotone retry improvement from smaller dt.
Do not call B_inf a qualified general nonlinear true-error upper bound.
Do not change F-SI24/F-SI25 indicator formula, Richards physics, boundary semantics, mass accounting or production source in this owner assessment.
Do not bind a candidate to F-KT09 production acceptance in F-SI26.
Do not release F-GC02, groundwater coupling or F-PE.
next_action: Perform source-bound candidate-class assessment against Gates A-I. If ABSOLUTE_HEAD_BUDGET_CONSUMPTION survives, define exact certificate semantics and independent F-VQ qualification requirements without selecting a default H_budget.
